spec_name: Google AdSense Publisher & Transaction Resolution Specification

transaction_lifecycle.step_1_earnings_accumulation: Daily impressions, clicks, and RPM logged across ad units.
transaction_lifecycle.step_2_end_of_month_finalization: Between the 1st and 3rd of the following month, estimated earnings are finalized.
transaction_lifecycle.step_3_payment_threshold: Accounts with balance >= $100.00 (or equivalent, e.g. Rp 1,300,000 IDR) qualify for payment release.
transaction_lifecycle.step_4_disbursement: Google dispatches payment between the 21st and 26th of the month via EFT / Wire Transfer.
transaction_lifecycle.step_5_reconciliation: Transaction reference, payout receipt, and tax forms (W-8BEN / US Chapter 3) reconciled via Gemini 3.8.

tax_withholding_rules.us_chapter_3_default: 30% withholding on US-sourced traffic without tax treaty claim.
tax_withholding_rules.tax_treaty_indonesia_us: Reduced withholding rate (typically 10% on royalties/digital services with valid NPWP/TIN and W-8BEN).

verification_checklist: ads.txt hosted on domain root returning HTTP 200 with text/plain.
Publisher ID matches the Google AdSense account ID exactly.
Payment receipt matches bank statement wire transfer reference.
